components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main submit on auth and teal-gradient actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; height: 50px; border: none; border-radius: 14px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5f9ea0, #4a8588); color: #fff; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(74, 133, 136, 0.35); transition: transform 0.12s, box-shadow 0.15s; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(74, 133, 136, 0.42); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5f9ea0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Surface CTA
components.description: White pill CTA on teal shell (empty state, primary actions on gradient).
components.css: .ds-btn-surface { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 14px 28px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; color: #2d6a6a; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-surface:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18); background: #f8fffe; } .ds-btn-surface-icon { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; background: #5f9ea0; color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Login and inspection text inputs on white sheets.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #3d5a5c; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1.5px solid #e2ecec; border-radius: 12px; background: #f8fafa; color: #1a2e30; font-size: 15px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9ab0b2; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #5f9ea0; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(95, 158, 160, 0.18); }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Dashboard project tile: white card on teal grid.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 18px; padding: 10px; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; color: #1a2e30; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-meta { display: block; font-size: 11px; color: #6a8082; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-card-badge { display: inline-block; margin-top: 8px; background: #ffd166; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 10px; color: #333; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Search Pill
components.description: Frosted search bar on dashboard shell.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35); padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search input { flex: 1; border: none; background: transparent; outline: none; margin: 0 8px; color: #fff; font-size: 15px; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Score / progress pill on inspection rows.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip-warn { background: #ffd166; color: #333; } .ds-chip-pass { background: #57cc99; color: #1a2e30; } .ds-chip-fail { background: #ef476f; color: #fff; }

narrative.overview: The interface behaves like a rugged clipboard you carry on site: a calm teal shell frames every task, and white panels hold the real work. Decoration stays minimal; hierarchy comes from size, weight, and the green progress ring.
keyCharacteristics: Teal gradient environment, white work surfaces
Semantic score colors: amber, green, red
Soft shadows, no nested card stacks

rules.name: The Shell vs. Sheet Rule
rules.body: Teal gradients belong to the phone shell only. Inspection content sits on white or #f8fafa sheets.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal is environmental; green is progress; amber is status. No fourth decorative accent.

rules.name: The Task Type Rule
rules.body: UI chrome in English; standard catalog content in Thai. Do not shrink Thai below 13px for density.

rules.name: The Flat Card Interior Rule
rules.body: Cards do not nest cards. Use borders and tints inside inspection sheets.

rules.name: The No Glass Default Rule
rules.body: Glass blur only on login logo mark. Not on dashboard cards or modals.

dos: Do keep the phone column at max-width 420px for inspection flows.
Do use white cards on teal for scannable project lists.
Do use verb + object button labels.
Do maintain WCAG AA contrast on white surfaces.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion on new animations.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS landing pages inside the app shell.
Don't use cream / sand warm-neutral AI default backgrounds.
Don't build dense admin dashboards with nested cards or side-stripe borders.
Don't hide inspection data behind playful consumer animations.
Don't treat the product like a dorm-finder or events marketplace.
Don't add gradient text, glassmorphism-by-default, or numbered section eyebrows.
Don't stretch project cards to fill grid row height.
